Location: Khorfakkan - Kuwait - Khorfakkan / Salalah / Dubai
Description:

A full crew is urgently required for a short-term project on an Oil Tanker (74,000 DWT). The vessel will undertake a direct voyage from Khorfakkan to Kuwait and back, with 12 days on articles. Alternatively, a two-leg voyage via Dubai is offered, including 8 days standby ashore with hotel covered. Joining is immediate. Candidates must be of Indian or Indonesian nationality, possess good English, valid STCW/CoC, medical, and all updated seafarer documents. A Hormuz transit bonus is provided.
